title: Adjournment Motion on a national energy resilience strategy using solar and battery microgrids
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion moved by Mr Azhar Othman proposing a national energy resilience strategy based on decentralised off-grid and micro-grid power solutions with solar photovoltaic generation and battery energy storage, followed by a response from Minister of State Gan Siow Huang.
why_it_matters: Mr Azhar Othman said public housing estates, which house 80% of our population, largely lack any form of backup beyond emergency lighting in stairwells, and that when the grid fails lifts and water pumps stop. He proposed that solar plus battery storage keep essential loads such as lifts and water pumps running during outages. Ms Gan Siow Huang said microgrids are one of several distributed energy solutions that will be studied further, subject to safety requirements and technical standards.

key_points.point: Mr Azhar Othman moved a Motion for a national energy resilience strategy.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: I rise today to move a Motion for a national energy resilience strategy

key_points.point: He said the Motion specifically concerns adoption of decentralised off-grid and micro-grid power solutions integrating solar photovoltaic generation and battery energy storage systems, along with a customised smart energy management solution.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: specifically the adoption of decentralised off-grid and micro-grid power solutions, integrating solar photovoltaic generation and battery energy storage systems, along with a customised smart energy management solution.

key_points.point: He declared that he is the Executive Chairman of an engineering firm that designs and integrates customised power systems and energy management solutions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: I am the Executive Chairman of an engineering firm that designs and integrates customised power systems and energy management solutions.

key_points.point: He said approximately 95% of Singapore's electricity is generated from natural gas, imported via pipelines from neighbouring countries and LNG terminals.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Approximately 95% of our electricity is generated from natural gas, imported via pipelines from neighbouring countries and liquefied natural gas (LNG) terminals.

key_points.point: He said public housing estates, which house 80% of the population, largely lack any form of backup beyond emergency lighting in stairwells.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Public housing estates, which house 80% of our population, largely lack any form of backup beyond emergency lighting in stairwells.

key_points.point: He proposed a layered, distributed architecture comprising three technical elements.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: I propose a layered, distributed architecture comprising three technical elements.

key_points.point: He gave a technical sizing example for Block 95 at Aljunied Crescent, saying the required BESS for 22 kilowatts by six hours, assuming a safe margin, is 132 kilowatt-hours.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: the required BESS for 22 kilowatts by six hours, assuming we take a safe margin, is 132 kilowatt-hours.

key_points.point: He gave a MacPherson constituency microgrid example, saying the total constituency storage is 14 megawatt-hour.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: The total constituency storage is 14 megawatt-hour.

key_points.point: He proposed scaling the design so each constituency becomes a grid-forming island capable of operating independently for eight to 24 hours without mainland utility power.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Each constituency becomes a grid-forming island, capable of operating independently for eight to 24 hours without mainland utility power.

key_points.point: He proposed a three-phase roll-out.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: I propose a three-phase roll-out.

key_points.point: He proposed Phase 1 as a 12-month pilot in one constituency, Macpherson or Sengkang.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Phase 1, 12 months. Pilot in one constituency – Macpherson or Sengkang.

key_points.point: He proposed Phase 2 as scaling to five constituencies over 24 months.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Phase 2, 24 months. Scale to five constituencies.

key_points.point: He proposed Phase 3 as nationwide rollout over 36 to 48 months.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: Phase 3, 36 to 48 months. Nationwide rollout.

key_points.point: He urged the Ministry to review and approve the establishment of a multi-agency task force including EMA, HDB, BCA and industry experts to pilot the first constituency-scale microgrid with solar and BESS.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: I urge the Ministry to review and approve the establishment of a multi-agency task force

key_points.point: Ms Gan Siow Huang said the Government recognises the importance of having a resilient and reliable grid to power the economy and daily lives.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: The Government recognises the importance of having a resilient and reliable grid to power our economy and our daily lives.

key_points.point: She said Singapore has one of the most reliable electricity grids in the world today.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Singapore has one of the most reliable electricity grids in the world today.

key_points.point: She said in 2025 the average power interruption time was less than one minute per customer on mainland Singapore and the average frequency of interruptions was about 0.02 times per customer.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: In 2025, the average power interruption time was less than one minute per customer on mainland Singapore and the average frequency of interruptions was about 0.02 times per customer.

key_points.point: She said EMA and SP Group developed the Future Grid Capabilities Roadmap last year to chart a clear direction for building new capabilities.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: EMA and SP Group developed the Future Grid Capabilities Roadmap last year to chart a clear direction for building new capabilities.

key_points.point: She said Sembcorp's large-scale battery energy storage system on Jurong Island is one example of deploying new physical assets to make the grid more resilient.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Sembcorp's large-scale battery energy storage system on Jurong Island is one example.

key_points.point: She said EMA will launch a Virtual Power Plant pilot.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: EMA will also launch a Virtual Power Plant pilot.

key_points.point: She said microgrids are one of several distributed energy solutions that will be studied further.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Indeed, microgrids are one of several distributed energy solutions that we will study further.

key_points.point: She said high power battery systems in HDB blocks also have to comply with SCDF fire safety standards, which could require additional space and safety infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: high power battery systems also have to comply with the Singapore Civil Defence Force's fire safety standards, which could require additional space and safety infrastructure in densely populated HDB blocks.

key_points.point: She said microgrid deployment could cost more to operate than larger grid systems and may offer lower power reliability if they lack sufficient reserves and redundancies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: They could cost more to operate than larger grid systems and may offer lower power reliability if they lack sufficient reserves and redundancies.

key_points.point: She said the Pulau Ubin Micro-Grid was launched in 2013 as an R&D testbed to reduce reliance on diesel for power generation on the island.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: The Pulau Ubin Micro-Grid was launched in 2013 as an R&D testbed to reduce reliance on diesel for power generation on the island.

key_points.point: She said the Government has set aside $800 million under the Decarbonisation Grand Challenge this year to support research and innovation in low-carbon technologies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: This year, the Government has set aside $800 million under the Decarbonisation Grand Challenge, to support research and innovation in low-carbon technologies.

key_points.point: Mr Azhar Othman said data centres are a highly huge power guzzler, typically about 70 MW to 100 MW per centre, and are running on diesel as a back-up.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman
key_points.quote: data centres, it is a highly huge power guzzler, typically about 70 MW to 100 MW per centre, and they are running on diesel as a back-up.

key_points.point: Ms Gan Siow Huang said she fully agrees that data centres are energy guzzlers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: I fully agree that data centres, they are energy guzzlers.

key_points.point: Mr Speaker said the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.

what_happens_next: The Sitting was adjourned at 9.24 pm; Mr Speaker said the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am. Ms Gan Siow Huang said microgrids are one of several distributed energy solutions that will be studied further.
